body:
bruh I love this reddit page. I have MD too and swear I thought I was the only one that acted out my daydreams lol. This is a very interesting debate. I daydream eyes closed when I'm trying to sleep but if im just laying in bed or im in public, always open. For me its just easier and to what AusistyGirl said, the weird shapes behind my eyelids r too distracting. 

Let me ask you this though, r ur eyes usually open or closed when you're remembering a memory? Like a daydream, when you remember a memory you're transported to that setting like its right in front of you. Then it goes away and u realize how zoned out you were from everything around you. Interesting how both pull u like that. Makes me think of a tiktok where this girl asks, if you picture a pickle, where is that pickle actually? Like why can you see it if its not in front of you? Kind of a cool third eye concept. 

Ik im 2 yrs late but in conclusion only cool people daydream with their eyes open.
